title: Board-deck SQL: Q3 net revenue by region
need: a revenue number for the board deck, as a SQL query you can trust
check: It runs the delivered query on 3 databases generated at check time (random customers, orders, lines and refunds, with orders on every quarter boundary) and compares each result with the right answer, so a query that runs fine but returns the wrong number fails.
strength: runs the query on 3 fresh randomized databases
mallory: a plausible query with the classic JOIN fan-out: refunds and line items multiplied together
bad_reason: the numbers match a known mistake: refunds and line items multiplied together
